name: TokenEconomizer (as a bundle)
summary: A hooks-only cost optimizer from Microsoft Research and partners, installed whole. Rejected as a bundle: its 18.4 to 30.9% saving is vendor-run, with no intervals, on a configuration other than the shipped default, and lower effort alone came close. Its default writes tool deny rules without per-change approval. v8 takes its ideas one at a time instead.

evidence.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22732 (TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents)
evidence.setting: 277 SWE-bench tasks, 3 seeds, 5 agent and model combinations, Claude Code 2.1.170; micro-skills on and a different loop guard, so not the shipped default; no intervals
Medium effort alone as a reference arm; not re-read
evidence.effect: Cost -16.8 to -28.9% at a 1.8 to 4.7-point pass-rate loss
Tool pruning and the loop guard are on by default; pruning writes a deny list after 60 idle minutes; toolprune=propose only proposes

egress.default: no telemetry (docs/v8/02-landscape.md); the loop guard's helper model calls go to the agent's own provider

revisit: independent replication with intervals on its shipped default
maintenance: Research plugin; v0.1.0 on 2026-10-26, with at least 44 commits since and no version bump.
